title: Sinominine alleviates pulmonary fibrosis by suppressing macrophage-to-myofibroblast transition via inhibition of the Frem1/NF-kappaB/IL-1beta axis.
authors: Zheng, Junhui; Du, Huaizhi; Ni, Haojie; Liu, Muqiu; Yu, Zhongyang; Dong, Yan; Guo, Yining
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药单体苦参碱通过Frem1/NF-kB/IL-1beta轴抑制巨噬细胞-肌成纤维细胞转化缓解肺纤维化，属纯湿实验与分子通路研究，无蛋白质-DNA互作、无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF) is a lethal interstitial lung disease with limited therapeutic options. Macrophage-to-myofibroblast transition (MMT) is a pivotal source of matrix-producing process in fibrosis, yet its regulatory mechanisms remain incompletely understood. METHODS: We employed a bleomycin (BLM)-induced murine model of IPF and an in vitro MMT model using MH-S alveolar macrophages. Histological (H&E, Masson's trichrome) and molecular (qPCR, Western blot, immunofluorescence) analyses were utilized to assess fibrosis, MMT, and pathway activity. Flow cytometry characterized macrophage populations. Key findings were validated through gene silencing (Frem1) and molecular docking. RESULTS: Sinominine significantly alleviated BLM-induced pulmonary fibrosis and collagen deposition. Mechanistically, SIN potently inhibited the MMT process, as evidenced by reduced expression of Acta2 and Col1a1. We identified Frem1 as a direct target of SIN, and demonstrated its central role in a pro-fibrotic IL-1beta signaling axis. The upregulation of Frem1 activates the MyD88/NF-kappaB signaling pathway and establishes a pathogenic positive feedback loop that amplifies IL-1beta production. Both genetic ablation of Frem1 and direct IL-1beta stimulation confirmed its non-redundant role in driving MMT. Crucially, the anti-fibrotic and anti-MMT effects of SIN were mediated through the targeted suppression of this Frem1/NF-kappaB/IL-1beta pathway. CONCLUSION: Our study unveils a novel mechanism whereby SIN ameliorates pulmonary fibrosis by directly targeting Frem1 to disrupt an IL-1beta-driven positive feedback loop and subsequent MMT.
abstract_zh: 背景：特发性肺纤维化（IPF）是一种致死性间质性肺疾病，治疗选择有限。巨噬细胞向肌成纤维细胞转化（MMT）是纤维化中基质产生过程的关键来源，但其调控机制尚未完全阐明。方法：我们采用博来霉素（BLM）诱导的IPF小鼠模型和MH-S肺泡巨噬细胞的体外MMT模型。利用组织学（H&E、Masson三色染色）和分子（qPCR、Western blot、免疫荧光）分析评估纤维化、MMT及通路活性。流式细胞术表征巨噬细胞群体。通过基因沉默（Frem1）和分子对接验证关键发现。结果：青藤碱显著减轻BLM诱导的肺纤维化和胶原沉积。机制上，SIN有效抑制MMT过程，表现为Acta2和Col1a1表达降低。我们鉴定Frem1为SIN的直接靶点，并证明其在促纤维化IL-1β信号轴中的核心作用。Frem1上调激活MyD88/NF-κB信号通路，并建立放大IL-1β产生的致病性正反馈环路。Frem1的基因消融和直接IL-1β刺激均证实其在驱动MMT中的非冗余作用。关键的是，SIN的抗纤维化和抗MMT效应通过靶向抑制该Frem1/NF-κB/IL-1β通路介导。结论：我们的研究揭示了一种新机制，即SIN通过直接靶向Frem1破坏IL-1β驱动的正反馈环路及随后的MMT，从而改善肺纤维化。
